_comment: Bulk film parameters for strain analysis (Angstrom). 'a' = in-plane bulk spacing, 'c' = out-of-plane bulk repeat in the same cell in which the (hkl) of the film reflections are given. Perovskites: pseudocubic cell (a = c). K2NiF4 cuprates: tetragonal I4/mmm cell (00l with even l). Poisson ratios are typical values; check them for your system. Override or extend in ~/.evaluation_program/films.json.

CaIrO3.note: perovskite polymorph, Pbnm a=5.35, b=5.59, c=7.67

La2CuO4.note: orthorhombic Bmab a=5.355, b=5.401 -> a_t = sqrt(ab/2)

La1.85Sr0.15CuO4.note: LSCO x = 0.15; add other x as separate entries
